ayahs.tr: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
From the evil of that which He created
And from the evil of darkness when it settles
ayahs.tl: Wa min sharri ghasiqin iza waqab

ayahs.tr: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
ayahs.tl: Wa min shar ri haasidin iza hasad
